sources.snippet: Conclusion Running Llama 3 locally gives you complete control over your AI infrastructure. Whether you choose the simplicity of Ollama, the flexibility of llama.cpp, or the production-readiness of vLLM, you now have the tools to deploy powerful AI on your own terms. The key is matching your hardware to the right model size and quantization level.
